citation: Saito, Aihara, Matsutani, and Narita (2020), Large-scale Open Dataset, Pipeline, and Benchmark for Bandit Algorithms.

sampling.method: Eight deterministic, evenly spaced HTTP byte ranges per source CSV; each range is parsed only between complete CSV row boundaries.
sampling.note: This bounded time-stratified sample is not the official 10,000-row example subset and is not a probability sample. Verify timestamp coverage and source row IDs before analysis.
